name: C2E2
blurb: Chicago's downtown pop-culture convention for comics, cosplay, gaming, anime and literary authors at McCormick Place.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'April 30 - May 2, 2027 McCormick Place.' (The page's own JSON-LD gives slightly different UTC timestamps for the same event; the visible banner text was trusted per instructions.)

notes: Guests page (and a retry at the ReedPop-pattern /guests/all-guests.html URL, which just redirected back to the same page) rendered with no real guest-card images -- only nav/footer chrome -- except one bare heading-level name, 'William Daniels', with no photo, bio or role text attached. Could not confirm a photo or credit for him, and did not want to guess his category, so the edition is recorded as guests: 'unavailable' rather than fabricating a pick. The guest grid likely needs further client-side interaction (a filter/category tab) that this renderer did not trigger.
